This Quarto notebook is the canonical executable source for `scripts/check_16s_environment.qmd`.
It verifies that every dependency of the delegated 16S workstream is installed,
records exact versions, and fails loudly rather than letting a later step
silently fall back to a different implementation.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/check_16s_environment.qmd [output_dir]
```

Automatic execution during rendering is disabled because this workflow writes
project outputs.

```{r}
#| label: check-16s-environment
#| echo: true
abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
output_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else Sys.getenv(
  "PHAGE_UV_16S_DERIVED",
  unset = file.path("derived", "16s_analysis")
)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

required_packages <- c(
  dada2 = "denoising, chimera removal, taxonomy assignment",
  Biostrings = "representative sequence handling and FASTA export",
  ShortRead = "raw read inspection and quality profiling",
  phyloseq = "integrated count, taxonomy, and sample-data object",
  vegan = "alpha diversity, dissimilarity, ordination, PERMANOVA",
  ggplot2 = "figure construction under the repository visual grammar"
)
optional_packages <- c(
  ALDEx2 = "optional exploratory compositional differential abundance",
  DECIPHER = "optional alignment for a phylogenetic tree",
  phangorn = "optional phylogenetic tree construction",
  ape = "optional tree import into phyloseq"
)

package_row <- function(pkg, purpose, requirement) {
  installed <- requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)
  data.frame(
    component = pkg,
    kind = "r_package",
    requirement = requirement,
    purpose = purpose,
    available = installed,
    version = if (installed) as.character(utils::packageVersion(pkg)) else NA_character_,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

rows <- do.call(rbind, c(
  Map(package_row, names(required_packages), required_packages, "required"),
  Map(package_row, names(optional_packages), optional_packages, "optional")
))

external_row <- function(command, purpose, requirement, version_args = "--version") {
  path <- unname(Sys.which(command))
  available <- nzchar(path)
  version <- NA_character_
  if (available) {
    version <- tryCatch(
      paste(system2(command, version_args, stdout = TRUE, stderr = TRUE), collapse = " "),
      error = function(e) NA_character_
    )
  }
  data.frame(
    component = command,
    kind = "external_tool",
    requirement = requirement,
    purpose = purpose,
    available = available,
    version = version,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

rows <- rbind(
  rows,
  external_row("cutadapt", "anchored degenerate primer removal", "required"),
  external_row("quarto", "notebook structure rendering", "optional"),
  data.frame(
    component = "R",
    kind = "runtime",
    requirement = "required",
    purpose = "analysis runtime",
    available = TRUE,
    version = paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
)

rows$version <- gsub("[\t\r\n]+", " ", rows$version)
rownames(rows) <- NULL

provenance_path <- file.path(output_dir, "16s_software_provenance.tsv")
write.table(rows, provenance_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

print(rows[, c("component", "requirement", "available", "version")])
cat(sprintf("\nWrote %s\n", provenance_path))

missing_required <- rows$component[rows$requirement == "required" & !rows$available]
if (length(missing_required)) {
  abort(
    "Missing required components: %s. Install them before running any later step.",
    paste(missing_required, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

missing_optional <- rows$component[rows$requirement == "optional" & !rows$available]
if (length(missing_optional)) {
  cat(sprintf(
    "Optional components not installed (their steps will be skipped): %s\n",
    paste(missing_optional, collapse = ", ")
  ))
}
cat("Environment check passed.\n")
```
